summary: 0 blocking, 1 warning, 1 note. Payload base (origin/main), project dir and HEAD 556c8185 match the dispatch prompt. The change is one coherent fix: the workload writes the stub hub plist via `as_user tee` instead of an admin mktemp file. It comes with a regression test that models macOS mktemp's private directory, and a runbook note on the NAT lease override. I checked the runbook note against the script: SOAK_SAMPLE_INTERVAL/SOAK_SAFETY_MARGIN and the dhcp.* attestation keys exist. The change-log entry and CHANGELOG.md cover all three deliverables. The scope tag matches the branch. The remaining mktemp uses are admin-only curl buffers. Degraded payload sections: `work` (no stated scope; I judged scope from the commits, and it is coherent), `build_plan` (no plan for this branch, so there are no Status boxes to check), and `backlog` (see note). No secrets, debug code or stray files. The worktree is clean.
